description: The U.S. Senate has advanced a $153 billion military construction and veterans affairs spending bill Tuesday that includes funding for an array of initiatives in Maine. Republican Sen. Susan Collins lauded those investments during a floor speech on Thursday, while also touting the bipartisan process leading to a 90-8 vote to advance the bill. Read […]
